summary: Runway Growth Finance Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a second quarter 2026 regular dividend of $0.33 per share, declared by the board on May 6, 2026. The record date is May 18, 2026, with payment on or about June 2, 2026. The company intends to distribute substantially all available earnings quarterly. This is a routine capital return declaration by the issuer, not tied to any special event such as a tender or activist campaign. What to watch: consistency of future dividend payments aligns with BDC sector norms; no risk-arb angle exists.
